map.标杆分析用于量化自身与行业/内部标杆的差距，明确改进优先级：: Benchmarking quantifies gaps against an industry or internal benchmark and sets improvement priorities:
map.相对差距 rel =（标杆值 − 自身值）÷ 标杆值；方向为 low（越低越好，: Relative gap rel = (benchmark value − own value) ÷ benchmark value; when the direction is low (lower is better, such as expense ratio or vacancy rate) the sign is inverted, so "better than benchmark" is negative and "behind" is positive.
map.综合差距评分 = 各项 |rel| 的均值 ×100%；按 |rel| 降序取: Composite gap score = mean of the |rel| values × 100%; sorting by |rel| descending takes the Top3 as priority improvement items.

map.标杆项目怎么选？: How should benchmark projects be chosen?
map.选同城市、同档次、规模相近且公开数据可信的项目，避免跨类型硬比导致结论失真。: Pick projects in the same city and tier with similar scale and credible public data, avoiding cross-category comparisons that distort the conclusion.
map.对标后只抄指标行吗？: Is copying only the metrics enough after benchmarking?
map.不行，要分析标杆背后的流程（排班、培训、回访），把做法本地化，而非只追数字。: No. Analyse the processes behind the benchmark (rostering, training, follow-up) and localise the practice rather than chasing numbers alone.

map.单项差距 = (标杆值 − 自身值) ÷ 标杆值（方向 low 时取反）；综合差: Per-item gap = (benchmark − own value) ÷ benchmark (negated when the direction is low); composite gap score = mean |gap| × 100%, the larger the value the more room for improvement; the top 3 by gap are prioritized
map.标杆对比、学习、超越分析工具按指标对比自身与标杆对象的差距，输出改进方向，适合物: Benchmark comparison, learning, and gap analysis: compares your metrics with a benchmark across indicators, outputs improvement directions, and supports benchmarking in property and operations management.
map.相对差距 rel = (标杆值 − 自身值) ÷ 标杆值（方向 low 时取反）: Relative gap rel = (benchmark − self) ÷ benchmark, negated when direction is low; rel > 0 is lagging, rel < 0 is leading; improvement score = weighted average rel of lagging items × 100%, excluding leading items; Top3 ranks by rel × weight descending
map.方向 high 表示越高越好（如毛利率、满意度）；low 表示越低越好（如费用率: High means higher is better (margin, satisfaction); low means lower is better (cost ratio, vacancy), and the gap is negated. Only lagging items (rel > 0) enter the improvement score and Top3; leading items (rel < 0) are listed separately and do not inflate the improvement score.
map.标杆值为 0 时相对差距无意义，页面改为显示绝对差并标注“相对差距不适用”，该行: A zero benchmark makes a relative gap meaningless; the page shows an absolute gap marked “relative N/A”, and that row is excluded from the weighted score. Each row may include an optional weight (default 1) and definition; invalid direction, number or weight is listed with the skip reason.

map.自身已经优于标杆会怎样？: What if we already beat the benchmark?
map.按方向判断为领先项，单独列出并计算平均优势，不再进入改进空间评分和优先改进 To: The direction makes it a leading item, listed separately with its average advantage; it no longer enters the improvement score or priority Top3, so a larger advantage is never mistaken for a greater need to improve.
map.标杆值为 0 怎么算？: How is a zero benchmark handled?
map.相对差距分母为 0，页面改为显示绝对差并标注“相对差距不适用”，该行不参与评分和: A relative gap would divide by zero, so the page shows an absolute gap marked “relative N/A”; that row is excluded from scoring and Top3.
